title: Question 15
passage:
Why is there a ribbon across the park bench?
A. The paint has not dried yet. B. I sat here yesterday afternoon. C. There is another bench by the pond.
passageZh:
公園長椅上為什麼橫著一條緞帶？
A. 油漆還沒有乾。 B. 我昨天下午坐過這裡。 C. 池邊還有另一張長椅。
